    # GET PARENT PATH
    # ==========================================================

    parentPath = str(
        self.view.params.Tag_Path_0
    )

    if not parentPath:
        return


    # ==========================================================
    # CHECK DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS UNDER PARENT
    # ==========================================================

    parentChildren = system.tag.browse(
        parentPath
    )

    parentAtomicPaths = []
    parentAtomicNames = []

    for child in parentChildren.getResults():

        if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":

            parentAtomicNames.append(
                str(child["name"])
            )

            parentAtomicPaths.append(
                str(child["fullPath"])
            )


    # ==========================================================
    # DETERMINE STARTING INDEX
    # ==========================================================

    dataIndex = 0


    # ==========================================================
    # CASE 1:
    # PARENT HAS DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
    # ==========================================================

    if len(parentAtomicPaths) > 0:

        parameterData = []

        values = system.tag.readBlocking(
            parentAtomicPaths
        )

        for i in range(len(parentAtomicPaths)):

            parameterData.append({

                "Parameter": parentAtomicNames[i],

                "Value": values[i].value
            })


        self.view.custom[
            "parameterData_0"
        ] = parameterData


        # First UDT starts at index 1
        dataIndex = 1


    # ==========================================================
    # CASE 2:
    # PARENT HAS NO DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
    # ==========================================================

    else:

        # First UDT starts at index 0
        dataIndex = 0


    # ==========================================================
    # GET UDT INSTANCES
    # ==========================================================

    results = system.tag.browse(
        parentPath,
        {
            "tagType": "UdtInstance"
        }
    )

    udtInstances = results.getResults()


    # ==========================================================
    # PROCESS ENABLED UDTs
    # ==========================================================

    for item in udtInstances:

        udtPath = str(
            item["fullPath"]
        )


        # ======================================================
        # CHECK ENABLED
        # ======================================================

        enabledPath = (
            udtPath + ".enabled"
        )

        enabledResult = system.tag.readBlocking(
            [enabledPath]
        )[0]

        if not enabledResult.value:
            continue


        # ======================================================
        # GET DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS INSIDE UDT
        # ======================================================

        childResults = system.tag.browse(
            udtPath
        )

        tagPaths = []
        tagNames = []


        for child in childResults.getResults():

            if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":

                tagNames.append(
                    str(child["name"])
                )

                tagPaths.append(
                    str(child["fullPath"])
                )


        # ======================================================
        # READ VALUES
        # ======================================================

        parameterData = []


        if len(tagPaths) > 0:

            values = system.tag.readBlocking(
                tagPaths
            )

            for i in range(len(tagPaths)):

                parameterData.append({

                    "Parameter": tagNames[i],

                    "Value": values[i].value
                })


        # ======================================================
        # STORE USING TAB INDEX
        # ======================================================

        propertyName = (
            "parameterData_" +
            str(dataIndex)
        )

        self.view.custom[
            propertyName
        ] = parameterData


        # ======================================================
        # NEXT ENABLED UDT
        # ======================================================

        dataIndex += 1

# ==================================================
    # GET VALUES

    if value is None:

    parentPath = str(value["tagPath"])

    currentIndex = value["currentIndex"]

    if currentIndex is None:
        currentIndex = 0

    currentIndex = int(currentIndex)

    if not parentPath:
        return []


    # ==================================================
    # TOOLTIP DATA
    # ==================================================

    manData = self.view.params.Man_Data

    tabs = []


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 1
    # CHECK FOR DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
    # ==================================================

    childResults = system.tag.browse(parentPath)

    hasAtomicTags = False

    for child in childResults.getResults():

        if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":

            hasAtomicTags = True
            break


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 2
    # CREATE COR001 TAB ONLY IF
    # DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS EXIST
    # ==================================================

    tabIndex = 0


    if hasAtomicTags:

        toolTipText = ""

        if manData is not None:

            if tabIndex < len(manData):

                dataItem = manData[tabIndex]

                if dataItem is not None:

                    toolTipText = str(
                        dataItem.get(
                            "tab_tooltip",
                            ""
                        )
                    )


        tabs.append({

            "viewPath": "widgets(templates)/TabButton",

            "viewParams": {

                # Parent UDT name
                "tabText": parentPath.split("/")[-1],

                # Tooltip
                "toolTipText": toolTipText,

                # Selected state
                "tabSelected": (
                    tabIndex == currentIndex
                )
            },

            "runWhileHidden": False
        })


        # COR001 occupied index 0
        tabIndex += 1


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 3
    # GET UDT INSTANCES
    # ==================================================

    results = system.tag.browse(
        parentPath,
        {
            "tagType": "UdtInstance"
        }
    )

    udtInstances = results.getResults()


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 4
    # CREATE TABS FOR ENABLED UDTs ONLY
    # ==================================================

    for item in udtInstances:

        udtPath = str(item["fullPath"])


        # --------------------------------------------------
        # CHECK ENABLED
        # --------------------------------------------------

        enabledPath = udtPath + ".enabled"

        enabledResult = system.tag.readBlocking(
            [enabledPath]
        )[0]


        if not enabledResult.value:
            continue


        # ==================================================
        # TOOLTIP
        # ==================================================

        toolTipText = ""

        if manData is not None:

            if tabIndex < len(manData):

                dataItem = manData[tabIndex]

                if dataItem is not None:

                    toolTipText = str(
                        dataItem.get(
                            "tab_tooltip",
                            ""
                        )
                    )


        # ==================================================
        # CREATE UDT TAB
        # ==================================================

        tabs.append({

            "viewPath": "widgets(templates)/TabButton",

            "viewParams": {

                # UDT name
                "tabText": str(item["name"]),

                # Tooltip
                "toolTipText": toolTipText,

                # Selected state
                "tabSelected": (
                    tabIndex == currentIndex
                )
            },

            "runWhileHidden": False
        })


        # Next visible tab
        tabIndex += 1


    # ==================================================
    # RETURN TABS
    # ==================================================
        # ==================================================
    # DEBUG
    # ==================================================

    logger = system.util.getLogger("DynamicTabsDebug")

    logger.info("========== TAB DEBUG ==========")

    for i in range(len(tabs)):

        logger.info(
            "INDEX = %s | TEXT = %s" % (
                i,
                str(
                    tabs[i]["viewParams"]["tabText"]
                )
            )
        )

    logger.info(
        "TOTAL TABS = %s" % len(tabs)
    )


    # ==================================================
    # RETURN TABS
    # ==================================================

    return tabs
